authorization.authorization_basis: user-directed comparison of the completed public-only LTX-2.3 preview with Seedance 2.0

scientific_distinction.shared_source_of_truth: the four frozen scenes and LTX prompt compiler in the completed public-only pilot
scientific_distinction.new_question: Does hosted Seedance 2.0 materially improve task-specific visual fidelity over the already-generated LTX-2.3 baseline?
scientific_distinction.not_authorized: using Seedance output for learner training or transmitting any ChildLens/BabyView-derived input

allowed: the four self-authored public-only episode plans in the completed pilot
the exact compiled LTX prompts from the completed pilot
the completed public-only LTX media and modular German audio
Seedance outputs and engineering manifests produced only from those public inputs
prohibited: ChildLens or BabyView transcripts, filenames, identifiers, vocabulary, prompts, statistics, embeddings, or other derivatives
restricted or private paths, credentials, or personal identifiers in API payloads or persisted records

candidate.label: Seedance 2.0 standard
candidate.model_version_characterization: closed hosted endpoint; exact weights and implementation revision are not exposed
candidate.returned_seed_policy: record the provider-returned generation seed in the attempt manifest

comparison.candidate_seed_comparability: The live Seedance endpoint does not expose an input seed, so its provider-selected seed cannot be matched to the LTX seed; this limitation must be reported.
comparison.native_audio_policy: Seedance native audio is disabled; every candidate final uses the exact AAC audio stream from its paired LTX final
comparison.delivery_policy: center-crop Seedance 1280x720 to 1280x704, normalize to 24 fps and 121 frames, then stream-copy the paired LTX audio
comparison.blinding: randomize family presentation order per scene from the work-order hash and keep the key outside the gallery

review.profile: single-rater blinded qualitative screening; not a formal model-selection result
review.speech_exclusion_reason: Every final candidate uses the exact paired LTX AAC stream, so speech is an identity control and is excluded from the visual-win rule.
review.cannot_judge_policy: Report cannot-judge counts; a scene with unequal judgeable visual-item counts is inconclusive and cannot count as a family win.

provider_cost.failed_or_moderated_request_billing: provider-dependent; no replacement attempt is authorized

direct_byteplus_reasons: published BytePlus Seedance terms state that the service is not available in the United States
published BytePlus Seedance terms prohibit using outputs for development or training of other models absent separate agreement
governance.fal_route_caveat: fal marks the endpoint for commercial use, but its terms also incorporate applicable third-party terms; non-competing research-training rights require written confirmation before any learner sees these outputs
governance.selection_rule: A visual win may support a recommendation to pursue clearance, but cannot authorize Seedance training use by itself
